about: The bench: tools UMS knows how to hand work to. `ums tools` checks which are installed and tells Claude, per job, which one to use and what to do differently. Same idea as Ultimate Frontend Skills' tools bench. Detection looks for plugin folders in the Claude Code plugin cache, skill folders in ~/.claude/skills and ~/.agents/skills, and programs on PATH; MCP servers and Claude in Chrome are seen in Claude's own tool list, not by a script.

tools.job: landing pages, store pages, share cards, reference images
tools.use: Hand pages to /ultimate-frontend-skills:webdesign, share cards to its link-preview skill, reference boards to its image deep research. UMS writes the copy; UFS builds the page.
tools.without: Write the page copy and structure in .ums/ and say that UFS would build and audit the page.

tools.use: Run /video-watch:watch-video on a competitor's ad or a trending video to read its hook, cuts and on-screen text frame by frame before writing a storyboard.
tools.without: Use ums video sheet on a downloaded clip you have rights to, or describe the reference from the ad library page.

tools.use: Check the usage reading before a full market run, long renders or a research fan-out, and order work so a cutoff costs little.
tools.without: Keep jobs to one week of content at a time.

tools.job: native desktop apps (CapCut, DaVinci Resolve, OBS)
tools.use: Drive a desktop editor only when the person asks for that app; publishing still stops before the final button.

tools.job: campaign briefs and performance reports with its connectors
tools.use: Use its performance-report with connected data for the weekly report; keep UMS's platform checks and approval queue for anything that goes out.
tools.without: Write the report from .ums/reports and manual exports.

tools.job: conversion, pricing, paywalls, referrals, programmatic SEO
tools.use: Hand page-conversion and pricing work to these skills; bring their recommendations back into the UMS calendar.
tools.without: Cover the basics in references/search.md and say marketingskills goes deeper (ums packs --only marketingskills).

tools.use: Use brand-voice to build .ums/voice.md from real writing; UMS's copy audit still runs on every post.
tools.without: Build the voice from samples by hand (references/copy.md).

tools.use: Use Remotion for animated product promos beyond slideshows and captions; check the company licence; export and check with ums video check.
Render web-page-based promos with HyperFrames, then ums video check and export.
Use the MJML skill for multi-column product grids; run ums email check on its output.
tools.without: Use ums email build (themes, cards, split sections).

tools.use: Use ums video build, check, export and sheet.
tools.without: Write storyboards and shot lists only, and never report a render as done.

tools.use: Transcribe the voiceover with word timestamps and pass the JSON as the storyboard captions.
tools.without: Caption from scene text or an SRT file.

seenByClaude.use: ad-library research and filling composers for assisted publishing
research and checking published posts in an isolated browser

seenByClaude.look: the bundled servers (HubSpot, Buffer, Canva, Klaviyo, Resend, MailerLite and the rest)
seenByClaude.use: real data and sending; one that needs authentication is signed in with /mcp
